title: The Package Nobody Ordered

scenes.narration: A package appeared outside my door with no name on it. I checked every delivery app, but there was no order.
Inside was a handwritten note thanking me for helping someone last winter. I had almost forgotten the day I stopped to help a stranger change a tire.
The package contained a small photo of that snowy roadside. It reminded me that tiny acts of kindness can stay with people for years.

description: An original fictional story about an unexpected thank you.
